|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-95-Odin_Nesloor_First_Aid-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6)]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “If your character’s forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. [Immune to Sense] OR Cancel an attempt to ‘operate’ on a character (who is also protected from any further attempts until start of opponent’s next turn). OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to ‘transport’ (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to ‘transport,’ or place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 35). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Odin Nesloor & •First Aid (Virtual Block 6) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) changed “free if reduced by” to “free if forfeit reduced by”, “a character (who is also protected … next turn)” to “a character; character is protected … next turn” and “place this Interrupt” to “place Interrupt”: “If your character's forfeit was just reduced to 0, use 1 Force (free if forfeit reduced by a [Permanent Weapon] weapon) to restore it to normal. (Immune to Sense.) OR Cancel an attempt to 'operate' on a character; character is protected from any further attempts until start of opponent's next turn. OR During your move phase, target any or all of your characters at one site to 'transport' (relocate) to an exterior or battleground site. Draw destiny. Use that much Force to 'transport,' or place Interrupt in Lost Pile.”.<ref name="cl-1261_105-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref>
